card.line: Gibeath-haaraloth is the place where Joshua circumcised the new generation of Israelites after they crossed into the promised land, following the LORD's command.

moments.title: Joshua circumcises Israel's sons
moments.text: The LORD told Joshua to make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel again. Joshua did this at Gibeath-haaraloth. These were the sons raised up after the men who left Egypt had died in the wilderness for not obeying the LORD.
